title: Sensitivity-Orthogonal Residual Learning for Adaptive Sideslip and Cornering Stiffness Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.27586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online adaptation of the cornering stiffness keeps a model-based sideslip estimator valid as tires change, but competes with learned model correction for the same filter innovation. A corrector with enough parameters can absorb the innovation pattern that a stiffness change produces, and adaptation is suppressed while the fit improves. We propagate the stiffness sensitivities of the predicted measurements through the vehicle states and construct a corrector orthogonal to them. A null-space parameterization enforces the constraint without a penalty coefficient and preserves the static least-squares stiffness estimate on each identification segment. In full-vehicle simulation, the stiffness response of the unconstrained corrector declines as its parameter count grows, whereas the orthogonal corrector responds at least as fully as the uncorrected filter at all sizes and lowers sideslip error by 12.7% to 22.0%. translated_title: 面向自适应侧偏角与侧偏刚度估计的灵敏度正交残差学习
translated_abstract: 侧偏刚度的在线自适应使基于模型的侧偏角估计器在轮胎特性变化时仍能保持有效，但它与学习到的模型修正器争夺同一个滤波新息。一个具有足够参数的修正器可以吸收刚度变化所产生的新息模式，导致在拟合改善的同时自适应被抑制。我们将预测测量的刚度灵敏度通过车辆状态进行传播，并构建了一个与这些灵敏度正交的修正器。零空间参数化在不使用惩罚系数的情况下强制执行该约束，并在每个辨识片段上保留静态最小二乘刚度估计。在整车仿真中，无约束修正器的刚度响应随着其参数数量的增加而下降，而正交修正器在所有参数规模下都至少能像未修正的滤波器那样充分响应，并将侧偏角误差降低12.7%至22.0%。在一次模拟驾驶中……
tldr: 该论文提出灵敏度正交残差学习方法，通过零空间参数化构建与刚度灵敏度正交的模型修正器，解决了学习修正器吸收滤波新息从而抑制侧偏刚度在线自适应的问题，将侧偏角估计误差降低12.7%至22.0%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sensitivity-orthogonal residual learning, which uses null-space parameterization to construct a corrector orthogonal to stiffness sensitivities, preventing learned corrections from absorbing filter innovations and suppressing stiffness adaptation, thereby reducing sideslip estimation error by 12.7% to 22.0%.
